latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Task Decomposer & Skill Generator.

- Decomposes complex user requests into atomic, executable subtasks with clear dependencies.
- Identifies required capabilities for each subtask using a universal capability taxonomy.
- Searches for existing skills on skills.sh to fulfill each subtask; recommends installation or new skill creation if needed.
- Provides comprehensive templates and instructions for creating new skills when gaps are identified.
- Supports automation of multi-step workflows and aids workflow planning by generating clear execution plans.
